map.算法（Parkland）：24h 总量 = 4 × 体重(kg) × 烧伤面积: Algorithm (Parkland): 24h total = 4 × weight (kg) × burn area TBSA (%) mL; infuse half in the first 8h and the other half in the following 16h; amount due at a given time = total × elapsed hours / 24. Weight and area must be >0.
map.例1（70kg、TBSA 30%）：24h=4×70×30=8400mL，前 8: Example 1 (70 kg, TBSA 30%): 24h = 4×70×30 = 8400 mL, first 8h = 4200 mL, following 16h = 4200 mL; if 8 hours have passed since injury, the amount due is 8400×8/24 = 2800 mL. Example 2 (60 kg, 40%): 24h = 9600 mL.
map.儿童/吸入伤怎么算？: How to calculate for children / inhalation injury?
map.儿童用改良 Brooke 或按体重更精细公式，吸入性损伤常需更多；Parklan: Children use the modified Brooke or a more refined weight-based formula, and inhalation injury often needs more; Parkland is only a preliminary adult estimate and must be adjusted per the burns-unit protocol and urine output (adults ≥0.5 mL/kg/h).
map.为什么要分前 8h 后 16h？: Why split into the first 8h and the following 16h?
map.伤后毛细血管渗漏最重在前 8h，半量快速补充恢复血容量；后 16h 渗漏减轻，匀: Capillary leak is greatest in the first 8h after injury, so half is given quickly to restore blood volume; in the following 16h the leak eases and the rest is given evenly to avoid pulmonary oedema.
map.前 8 小时输半量：t ≤ 8h 时累计应输 = 半量 × t ÷ 8: First 8 hours: half the volume — when t ≤ 8 h, cumulative volume to infuse = half volume × t ÷ 8
map.后 16 小时输另半量：t > 8h 时累计应输 = 半量 + 半量 × (t: Following 16 hours: the other half — when t > 8 h, cumulative volume = half volume + half volume × (t − 8) ÷ 16
map.总量 = 前 8h 半量 + 后 16h 半量（各占 1/2，不是 24h 平均: Total volume = first-8 h half + following-16 h half (each 1/2, not an even split over 24 h)
map.计时自受伤时刻起算，已输注时间限制 0–24h: Timing starts at the moment of injury; elapsed infusion time is clamped to 0–24 h
map.算法（Parkland）：24h 总量 = 4 × 体重(kg) × 烧伤面积: Algorithm (Parkland): 24 h total = 4 × body weight (kg) × burn area TBSA (%) mL; half is given in the first 8 h and the other half in the following 16 h. Segmented cumulative: when t ≤ 8 h, cumulative = half volume × t ÷ 8; when t > 8 h, cumulative = half volume + half volume × (t − 8) ÷ 16; t starts at the moment of injury and is clamped to 0–24 h. Weight and area must be > 0.
map.例1（70kg、TBSA 30%）：24h=4×70×30=8400mL，前 8: Example 1 (70 kg, TBSA 30%): 24 h = 4×70×30 = 8400 mL, first 8 h = 4200 mL, following 16 h = 4200 mL; if 8 hours have elapsed since injury, cumulative volume = 4200×8÷8 = 4200 mL (half the total), not 2800 mL as an even 24 h split; if 12 hours have elapsed, = 4200 + 4200×4÷16 = 5250 mL. Example 2 (60 kg, 40%): 24 h = 9600 mL.
map.已输注 8 小时，为什么累计应是总量的一半，而不是三分之一？: After 8 hours of infusion, why should the cumulative volume be half the total rather than one third?
map.Parkland 的前 8h 半量是独立时段目标，不是把 24h 总量平均分摊：: Parkland's first-8 h half is an independent period target, not an even spread of the 24 h total: for t ≤ 8 h it accumulates as "half volume × t/8", reaching exactly 1/2 of the total at 8 h; only after t > 8 h does the following-16 h "half volume × (t − 8)/16" phase start, reaching the full total at 24 h. An even 24 h split would deliver only 1/3 by 8 h (e.g. 2800 mL instead of 4200 mL for 70 kg, 30%), underestimating early resuscitation.
